steps.text:
Put the paper filter into your Aeropress and close it.
Place it on a mug or a similar container.
Add {coffee} grams of coffee to your aeropress

Add {water} ml of water to your aeropress.
Using a scale is recommended.
Insert plunger slightly and wait for 2.5 minutes.
Gently push the plunger all the way to the bottom.
